restaurantName: Bánh Cuốn Gia Truyền Thanh Vân (Hang Ga Street)
address: 14 Hang Ga Street, Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi, 110000, Vietnam
bio: As its name suggests, this long-standing family-run spot specialises in bánh cuốn, keeping alive a craft passed down through generations. Everything is made from scratch using traditional methods, resulting in rice rolls that are thin, delicate and soft. The family-recipe dipping sauce strikes a pleasing balance of salty, sweet and sour. Fillings include pork, shrimp and chicken, with extra toppings available. The bún thang, a Hanoi-style noodle soup with assorted toppings, is also worth trying.
pageTitle: Bánh Cuốn Gia Truyền Thanh Vân (Hang Ga Street)
